text:
Marco (Sales): quick one — Acme wants to close this week. Finance says they need a PO and invoice on net30, legal flagged a DPA appendix and an SLA tweak for dedicated capacity. can we lock the signing path?
Sophia (Sales Ops): do we have the final order form? i have two versions (v3 with SLA vs v2 without). which one to send?
Marco (Sales): send v3 (SLA included) but i need confirmation on the signer lane — customer requires exec + procurement signatures. also need payment contact for invoice.
Anya (Legal): @Marco (Sales) please confirm: is customer asking for any new subprocessor lists or EU SCCs? also need to know whether they insist on HSM/KMS for keys — that affects DPA redlines.
Marco (Sales): they attached a security note: "prefer HSM, but will accept KMS with SOC2+A". no SCCs requested explicitly, but they asked for data-residency in eu-west-1.
Raj (Solutions): if we include private deployment language (VPC), SLA latency targets bump. that will require a Dedicated cluster commit. pricing team — note potential uplift.
Sophia (Sales Ops): billing contact is "accounts-payable@acme.co". PO placeholder:```
PO: ACME-2026-07
Amount: $120,000
Terms: Net 30
```
Sophia (Sales Ops): i can route doc via DocuSign. do we have an exec-sign slot? we normally have 2-step: procurement -> exec.
Anya (Legal): i looked at v3, proposed a limited DPA appendix redline: remove unlimited indemnity for subprocessor failures, add KMS/HSM scoping clause, and limit audit window to 90 days notice. will post redline in the thread shortly.
FinBot (billing-bot): Invoice draft generated: https://invoices.redwood.local/preview/ACME-2026-07 (internal link) :white_check_mark:
Marco (Sales): thanks. plan: Sophia to send v3 + my note about exec lane, attach PO and invoice link; Anya to drop redline; Raj to confirm dedicated commit and estimated monthly charge.
Raj (Solutions): estimate uplift for Dedicated w/ SLA = +30% monthly. need approval from pricing on final quote.
Sophia (Sales Ops): starting DocuSign envelope now, tagging procurement as primary signer. exec slot left as pending.
Anya (Legal): redline uploaded: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/attachment/12345/ACME_DPA_redline.docx — key changes summarized: KMS scoping, limited indemnity, audit cadence + eu-residency clause.
Marco (Sales): @Anya (Legal) can you confirm whether redline is acceptable for PO-based procurement vs full countersignature? procurement prefers stamp vs countersign to speed.
Anya (Legal): we can accept countersign by procurement for PO <= $150k if DPA appendix signed and KMS clause present. exec signature only needed for contractual deviations.
Sophia (Sales Ops): envelope status: sent to procurement, waiting. estimated time to complete: ~24-48h.
Marco (Sales): ping me when procurement signs, will coordinate with customer exec for final sign-off. :thumbsup:
Sophia (Sales Ops): noted — i'll escalate to ACME AP if no response in 12h.
FinBot (billing-bot): Reminder scheduled: send invoice on signing.
Marco (Sales): closing plan set. thanks all.
